You telephoned on 25th November 2025 at 10.44am - we ask if patients require an urgent same day appointment that they call at 8.30am. Even though it was 10.44am the team placed you on the list for a call as they understood you were unwell and wanted to help you. Our Consultant Paramedic telephoned you at 17.44pm and you did not answer - if you were too unwell to answer the phone I am unclear why you requested the Clinician to call and perhaps you would have been better to contact 111 as we are not an emergency service.  There are plenty of pharmacies open until the evening where you could have obtained medication. Alex left you a message advising you he was not able to call again, but for you to call us back if you still needed help. We did not hear from you again until 28th November 2025 when you spoke to a Receptionist at 8.46am and were offered a same day appointment and were seen by Dr Rahman at 9.50am.
